body:
SecondDawnBlocks

SecondDawnBlocks is a large-scale sci-fi building expansion mod designed to give players powerful, flexible tools for creating immersive futuristic environments.

Textures provided by AstralSapphire, IPanic, Nystoke, SpearmintMagpie, and other members of the TrekCraft Community. Check out their discord!

Thank You for Going Boldly in Your Builds for 15 years!

🧱 Features
Massive Panel System
Hundreds of unique sci-fi textures
Clean, modular designs for ships, stations, and interiors
Full Block Families
Blocks
Stairs
Slabs
Walls (fully connected)
Trapdoors
Advanced Building Pieces
Vertical slabs
Layer blocks
Corner stairs
Quarter blocks (horizontal & vertical)
Consistent Material Sets
Color-coordinated palettes
Industrial, clean, and futuristic styles
Designed for large-scale builds

🚀 Designed For
Starships and space stations
Sci-fi interiors and corridors
Roleplay environments
Large modular builds

⚙️ Technical
Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.1
Requires installation on both client and server
Fully integrated with vanilla block behavior
🧠 Philosophy

This mod focuses on building freedom and consistency, giving players a complete toolkit to create detailed environments without limitations from vanilla block shapes.

⚠️ Notes
This mod is focused on building and does not include gameplay mechanics
Designed to pair with roleplay or systems-based mods (such as SecondDawnRP)
